description: Archive a category that nothing uses, e.g. a starter category the organization does not need. Refused, with nothing written, while anything still uses it: items (drafts too), sub-categories, item models, fields defined on it, a maintenance plan that selects it, or an item kit that lists it; the answer names what. An archived category leaves every list and picker, and the app has no way to bring it back. Repeating the call on an archived category answers alreadyArchived and writes nothing. Requires the manager role.
name: archive_category

alreadyArchived.description: It was archived before this call

archived.description: True = archived; false = refused, nothing written

inUse.description: On a refusal, what still uses it: items, drafts, subCategories, models, fields, maintenancePlans, kits (counts)

readLimitReached.description: Areas this check could not read in full — refused for safety, nothing written

title: Archive unused category
